title: Reporting every problem
hints: errors.Join(errs...) combines several errors into one. It returns nil when every argument is nil (or there are none), and errors.Is / errors.As search all of the joined errors.
Collect a *FieldError for each problem into a []error, then return errors.Join(problems...). Don't stop at the first problem.
var errs []error; if u.Name == "" { errs = append(errs, &FieldError{"name", "must not be empty"}) }; …the same for email and age…; return errors.Join(errs...)
